# try get something from r
```{r}
r_use = r %>% select(dv, pid1, pid2, sgroup, pgroup, DET, content, type)  %>% filter(type != 'trailer')
```

```{r}
r_mean <- r_use %>% filter(!is.na(DET)) %>% group_by(dv, pid1, pid2) %>% summarise(meanDET = mean(DET))
```

```{r}
p_info = pd %>% select(pid, condition, social, Date)
r_mean = left_join(r_mean, p_info, by = c('pid1' = 'pid'))
r_mean = left_join(r_mean, p_info, by = c('pid2' = 'pid'), suffix = c('_1', '_2'))
```

```{r}
r_mean <- r_mean %>% mutate(condition_sgroup = ifelse(condition_1 == condition_2, 'in', 'out'), condition_pgroup = ifelse(condition_sgroup == 'in', condition_1, 'out')) %>% mutate(sgroup = ifelse(condition_pgroup == 'movie' & Date_1 != Date_2, 'out', 'in')) %>% mutate(pgroup = ifelse(condition_pgroup == 'movie'&Date_1 != Date_2, 'out', condition_pgroup))  %>% mutate(social_sgroup = ifelse(social_1 == social_2, 'in' , 'out'), social_pgroup = ifelse(social_1 == social_2, social_1 , 'out')) %>% mutate(social_sgroup = ifelse(social_pgroup == 'Individual', social_pgroup, social_sgroup))

r_mean <- r_mean %>% mutate(pgroup = ifelse(Date_1 == Date_2, condition_pgroup, 'out')) %>% rename('condition' = 'condition_pgroup')
r_mean <- r_mean %>% mutate(sgroup = ifelse(Date_1 == Date_2, 'in', 'out'))
```


```{r}
lm(data = r_use %>% filter(sgroup == 'in' & dv == 'HR'), DET ~ type) %>% summary()

membership_mx = lmerMultiMember::weights_from_columns(subset(r_mean, dv == 'HR')[,c('pid1','pid2')])

contrasts(r_mean$condition)

r_mean$condition <- as.factor(r_mean$condition)
contrasts(r_mean$condition) <- c(-1,1)

mod_mm_1  <- lmerMultiMember::lmer(data = subset(r_mean, dv == 'HR'), meanDET ~ condition + (1|pair), memberships = list(pair = membership_mx)) 
mod_mm_1 %>%  summary(ddf = 'Kenward-Roger')
emmeans(mod_mm_1, specs = 'condition_pgroup')

ggplot(data = subset(r_mean, dv == 'HR' & sgroup != 'out'), aes(x = pgroup, y = meanDET, colour = pgroup, fill = pgroup)) + 
  geom_half_violin(side = 'r', linewidth = 0,trim = FALSE, alpha = .7) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5, shape = 18, position = position_dodge(.5)) +
  #stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line",linewidth = 1, color = "black", linetype = 1, alpha = .1) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_nudge(x = -.125), alpha = .1, width = .1, notch = TRUE, whisker.linewidth = 1.25, staplewidth = .25, staple.linewidth = 1) + 
  #geom_half_point(side= 'l', shape = 124,  range_scale = 0,   size = 3.5,   width = 1,   alpha = .5) +
  ylab('HR synchrony') + xlab('Condition') + 
  coord_flip() + 
  theme_ggdist() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = 'condition', labels = c('movie' = 'film'), values = cols4all::c4a('wes.darjeeling2',2)) + 
  scale_color_manual(name = 'condition', labels = c('movie' = 'film'), values = cols4all::c4a('wes.darjeeling2',2)) + 
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c('book', 'movie')), y_position = 97, colour = 'black', map_signif_level = TRUE, tip_length = 0)  + 
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = c("group" = "film co-watch")) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), axis.text = element_text(size = 18), legend.text = element_text(size = 18), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 18)) 


ggsave('aladdin main DET.png', width = 1920, height = 1440, units = 'px')

```


## Self reports
```{r}
pd <-  pd %>% mutate(
    pre_mean  = rowMeans(across(starts_with("pre_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    post_mean = rowMeans(across(starts_with("post_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    pe_mean = rowMeans(across(starts_with("pe_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    eng_mean = rowMeans(across(starts_with("eng_")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r}
lm(data = pd, eng_mean ~ condition) %>% summary()
lm(data = pd, pre_mean ~ condition) %>% summary()
lm(data = pd, post_mean ~ condition) %>% summary()
lm(data = pd, pe_mean ~ condition) %>% summary()
```

### Run some FA or PCA?
```{r}
#37:84, 86:93

pca_scale <- pd[, c(57:84, 86:93)] %>% na.omit()

pca_scale_scaled <- scale(pca_scale)
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_scale_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

plot(pca_result, type = "l")

pca_result
# Summary: variance explained
summary(pca_result)

biplot(pca_result)

head(pca_result$rotation[, 1:3])

sort(abs(pca_result$rotation[, 1]), decreasing = TRUE)

scores <- pca_result$x
head(scores)


scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores)

combined <- cbind(pd[rownames(scores_df), ], scores_df)

ggplot(combined, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = condition)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  #scale_shape_manual(values =  c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6,15,16,17)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA: Participants in Component Space")


```

```{r}
pca_scale %>% scree(pc=F) # 3?

factanal(pca_scale, factors = 3, scores='regression', rotation = 'promax') 
```

```{r}
corr_result <- lapply(names(pd_smaller)[2:25], function(col) {
  test <- cor.test(pd_smaller[[col]], pd_smaller$meanDET, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  data.frame(
    Variable = col,
    Correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value,
    CI_lower = test$conf.int[1],
    CI_upper = test$conf.int[2]
  )
})

cor_summary <- do.call(rbind, corr_result)
```

```{r}
split_data <- split(pd_smaller, pd_smaller$type)

# Loop over each type group and run your correlation logic
cor_by_type <- lapply(names(split_data), function(type_name) {
  df_group <- split_data[[type_name]]
  
  corr_result <- lapply(names(df_group)[2:25], function(col) {
    test <- cor.test(df_group[[col]], df_group$DET, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    data.frame(
      type = type_name,
      Variable = col,
      Correlation = test$estimate,
      p_value = test$p.value,
      CI_lower = test$conf.int[1],
      CI_upper = test$conf.int[2]
    )
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, corr_result)
})

# Combine all results into one dataframe
cor_summary_by_type <- do.call(rbind, cor_by_type)


```

## run a pca again
```{r}
pd_pca_scaled <- pd_smaller %>% select(social_connect, social_ios, social_like, post_BMIS_pu, post_BMIS_ac,  post_BMIS_pt, post_BMIS_nr, eng_attention, eng_character, eng_character, eng_narrative, eng_presence, pe_captive, pe_emotion, pe_social, pe_spirit) %>% na.omit() %>% scale()

pd_pca_totalscores <- pd_smaller %>% select(Pre_BMIS, Post_BMIS, PE_BnN, eng_engagement, Social_Scale, meanDET) %>% na.omit() %>% scale()



library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)


pca_res <- PCA(pd_pca_scaled, graph = TRUE)

fviz_eig(pca_res)  # scree plot
fviz_pca_biplot(pca_res, repel = TRUE)


```


```{r}
raw_items <-  pd[,c(37:52, 61:84)] %>% na.omit() %>% scale()
pca_raw <- PCA(raw_items, graph = TRUE)

scores <- pca_raw$ind$coord %>% as.data.frame()

pd_pca <- pd %>% filter(!is.na(pe_captive)) %>% select(pid, condition) %>% bind_cols(scores) 

pd_pca <- left_join(pd_pca, pd_smaller %>% select(pid, meanDET))
lm(data = pd_pca, Dim.1 ~ condition) %>% summary()
lm(data = pd_pca, Dim.2 ~ condition) %>% summary()
```
